howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Three steps to get concrete data from your movement.

step1.title: Upload Your Video
step1.description: Select a training video from your device. Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV and WebM up to 100MB.

step2.title: Automatic Processing
step2.description: The system analyses every frame and automatically detects body keypoints or the barbell.

step3.title: See the Results
step3.description: 3D skeleton, joint angles, barbell path, velocity curves and rep count.

types.title: Two Types of Analysis
types.description: Choose the analysis that best fits your training goal.

motion.title: Motion Analysis
motion.description: Automatic pose detection for any sports movement. Generates a 3D skeleton and calculates joint angles frame by frame.

lift.title: Lift Analysis
lift.description: Automatic barbell tracking for weightlifting exercises. Get bar path, velocity and rep count.

sports.title: Works for Any Sport
sports.description: Pose detection works with any type of movement — from lifting to running, gymnastics or martial arts.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

faq.a2: Upload a video of any sports movement. The system detects body keypoints, generates a 3D skeleton and calculates joint angles frame by frame.
faq.q3: What is Lift Analysis used for?
faq.a3: For barbell exercises — squat, deadlift, snatch, etc. The system automatically tracks the bar path, measures velocity and counts reps.
faq.a4: Yes, completely free. Upload your video and get the results.
faq.a5: We support MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV and WebM up to 100MB.
